title: Resend media placeholder
description: The stand-in for a photo, screenshot, video or 3D scene: a muted panel with a hairline and a soft top-down fade, a glossy app-icon square with a faint violet glow under it, or a circle for avatars. Size and radius come from the slot.
notes: purely decorative (aria-hidden); swap it for an img, video or canvas of the same size
name: resend-placeholder

props.name: shape
props.description: panel: a muted surface (screenshots, scenes) · tile: a glossy app-icon square with a glow under it · round: a circle (avatars, marks)

props.name: className
props.description: size, radius and position of the slot it fills
